detail.longDescription: 🧦 NEW: A team at the University of # Texas tested custom # socks with a tight knitted band around the forefoot to see why # humans evolved stiffer # feet than other # primates . Keeping the arch locked stiffened the foot lengthwise by 65% and helped calf # muscles contract more slowly, saving as much # walking # energy as dropping 2 kg (4.4 lb) from your waist. 👉 https://www. sciencealert.com/scientists-de veloped-foot-stiffening-socks-that-could-make-walking-less-tiring # biomechanics # evolution # biology # science # anatomy # health # physics # engineering # research
